p.em: set-algebra combinators nest over base cursors — each implements DictZipper,
pulling from its operand cursors lazily

text.tspan: is_final = ALL operands final · descend = ALL

div.p: Color key · 🟦 blue = consumer driving the pull · 🟨 amber = set-algebra combinator (lazy, owns no storage) ·
🟩 green = in-memory backend cursor (leaf DictZipper) · ⬜ grey = arrows / borders.
Every combinator is itself a DictZipper, so operands may be backends or further combinators.
